text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a short preflight 'node warmdown + network-shaping' test Sat 01:30-04:30 UTC in us-east1. Goal: validate our graceful drain under incipient NIC congestion and confirm autoscaler backfill behavior.

 tiffany: what's the blast radius? which pools/racks?

 alex: We'll target 4 cohorts across az.us-east1-a/b/c (approx 40 racks, ~160 GPUs total) with staggered 15m cordon windows. Expected steady-state capacity loss ~2-3% per cohort. Full plan attached inline.

 mike: any customer-facing risk? SLAs?

 alex: Low but non-zero. We expect a few short 5-15s tail latency spikes on hosted API routes during VM egress rebalancing. Canary metrics required: p95/p99 gen latency, queue_length, and instance_restarts. Rollback if sustained p99 > baseline + 200ms for 5m.

 sara: ops checklist? who runs canaries and rollbacks?

 alex: Checklist (condensed):
 - pre-check: confirm KV-cache warmup keys seeded into 10% of backfill pool
 - throttling: tc netem on nic -> 20% packet delay to simulate congestion
 - drain: cordon + drain (grace 60s) with node-svc-fence tag
 - monitor: dashboards for gen-latency, host_cpu, egress_errors, autoscaler_fill
 - rollback: uncordon + cancel drain if trigger hit

 mike: cost implications?

 alex: Short probe: expected extra reserved burst capacity ~12 GPUs for 2h across AZs. Estimated incremental cost ~$1.1k (cloud instances + spillover reserved compute). Will open expense ticket.

 tiffany: timings look good. can we reduce 15m windows to 10m if metrics stable?

 alex: yes, plan allows shrink after first cohort if p95/p99 < baseline + 50ms and no egress_errors

 deploy-bot: scheduled test job created: job_id=proj-nettest-202803-7419876543, will run 2028-03-18T01:30:00Z

 oncall-bot: reminder 30m before start; paging policy: infra-oncall -> sms if rollback triggered

 sara: I'll own canaries and gate. Alex, ping me 30m before to validate KV keys seeded.

 alex: thanks. I'll post the more detailed runbook and the public-facing comm draft to #customer-comms by EOD today. Any objections?

 mike: none from me. :thumbsup:

 tiffany: good to go.

 alex: OK locking in. Will post final start message 30m before. Will include the exact racks and cohort mapping.
